why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: Open task.simplechain.com , connect an EVM wallet such as MetaMask and sign the login message. It costs no gas. Warning Use a wallet that holds no real funds. The login box comes already ticked to accept a Terms of Service and Privacy Policy that the portal doesn't link to.
Add the testnet to your wallet if it asks: Network name: SimpleChain Testnet
Request test SRW from the faucet . You can ask once every 24 hours.

Link your X account and either Telegram or Discord in the portal. Several tasks won't count without them. Warning These links tie your social accounts to your wallet address, and the Telegram link asks for write access.
On the Daily tab, claim the check-in and the website visit every day.

On the OnChain tab, swap and add liquidity on the testnet exchange, and stake test SRW with a validator. Unstaking takes seven days. Warning When we checked on 7 October 2026, the exchange that the swap tasks open showed an expired security certificate. Don't click past a browser warning with a wallet you care about.
On the Social tab, follow, repost and reply on X, and join the Telegram group and the Discord server from the task cards.
Check your rank on the leaderboard .
